brief.objective: Create a candid vertical lip-tint lifestyle image
brief.promise: A touch-up that belongs to real life

prompt.casting: One fictional adult East Asian woman with brief-appropriate contemporary styling
prompt.makeup_skin: Sheer satin base with visible pores and tonal variation; no oily or glass-plastic highlights
prompt.makeup_brows: Soft straight brows with diffused fronts and clean tapered tails
prompt.makeup_eyes: Rose-beige wash, fine brown tightline, short horizontal wing, separated wispy lashes
prompt.makeup_cheeks: Translucent peach-pink blush placed high and slightly central; minimal neutral contour
prompt.makeup_lips: Rose-coral tint with a softly blurred edge and believable balm reflection
prompt.makeup_finish: Warm-neutral palette, skin tone locked across face and neck, editorial cleanup only
prompt.subject_action: One fictional adult East Asian woman applying lip tint while looking away from camera
prompt.scene: Late-afternoon neighborhood cafe beside a window
prompt.composition: Subject center-right with natural headline space on the left
prompt.camera_geometry: Friend-held camera near eye level from conversational distance
prompt.lens_distance: 24-28mm phone main-camera behavior without close-range facial distortion
prompt.focus_depth: Face and applicator contact sharp; natural environmental falloff without synthetic portrait blur
prompt.motion_shutter: Stable face with slight motivated hand movement
prompt.sensor_color: Plausible low-light phone noise, restrained sharpening, mixed window and warm indoor white balance
prompt.lighting: Window key camera-left with visible warm practical ambience
prompt.fill_separation: Natural room bounce roughly one to two stops under the window key
prompt.background_treatment: Cafe background remains legible but subordinate, with no cloned patrons
prompt.materials: Natural skin texture, realistic hair, fabric tension, hands, and lip applicator contact
prompt.negative_constraints: No plastic skin, beauty filter, extreme V-line, extra fingers, fake product text, or influencer grin
